name: Export skins, joints, and inverse-bind matrices
description:
## Why
6/18 models have Skeleton + 305 Bones + JOINTS/WEIGHTS. Mesh is saved at bind pose; binding is dropped. Data is already in `model_file.bin` + `file.osgjs` — no extra fetch.

## Scope
`lib/osgjs2gltf.js`: JOINTS_0 / WEIGHTS_0, skins, skeleton, inverse-bind matrices from osgAnimation.Skeleton / Bone / RigGeometry. Needs the named node tree from the hierarchy leaf.

## Verification
A skinned sample GLB has skins + JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 and a skeleton. Bind-pose mesh still renders. `node --test`. Same-file as morphs — finish this before starting morphs.

## Plan
`.context/plans/recover-dropped-gltf-features.md` + `.context/FINDINGS.md`
result:
## Changed
RigGeometry exports glTF skins. Bones/Weights → JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0. BoneMap joint i maps to the Bone node of that name; JOINTS_0 stays osg indices into skins[].joints. InvBindMatrixInSkeletonSpace conjugated with the same R as node matrices. Skeleton node set on skin.skeleton.

## Files
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js`
- `test/skins.test.js`

## Verification
- `npm test`: 74 pass / 0 fail
- Synthetic 2-bone RigGeometry: skin, JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0, conjugated IBM
- Finger_on_a_board_Animated convert has skins + bind-pose POSITION
- Reviewer: PASS (fresh npm test 74/74)

## Risks
Incomplete BoneMap drops that skin (mesh still at bind pose). Shared SourceGeometry UniqueID could reuse the first BoneMap. Large rigs not converted in this leaf.

name: Keep morph targets instead of flattening
description:
## Why
5/18 models have MorphGeometry; we keep the base mesh and drop targets. Data is already in `model_file.bin`. Morph-weight clips come later with animations.

## Scope
`lib/osgjs2gltf.js`: emit glTF morph targets from osgAnimation.MorphGeometry instead of `extractMeshGeometry` flattening. Blocked by skinning because both rewrite the same walk/emit path.

## Verification
A morph sample GLB has extras/targets on the mesh; base still matches today’s look at weight 0. `node --test`.

## Plan
`.context/plans/recover-dropped-gltf-features.md` + `.context/FINDINGS.md`
result:
## Changed
MorphGeometry keeps MorphTargets. Base mesh still decoded via processGeometry (weight 0 matches flatten). Each target decoded the same way; glTF stores Y-up POSITION+NORMAL deltas. mesh.weights all 0; extras.targetNames from osg Name. Rig+Morph unwrap so skins and morphs can share a mesh.

## Files
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js`
- `test/morphs.test.js`

## Verification
- `npm test`: 77 pass / 0 fail
- Synthetic triangle: Y-up delta, flatten match
- Chainsaw convert: 7 targets, weights 0, no animations[]; deltas not absolute
- Reviewer: PASS (fresh npm test 77/77 + convert inspect)

## Risks
Targets needing parallelogram prediction use base strip indices. TANGENT morphs not emitted. Weights stay 0 until the animation leaf.

name: Emit real vertex colors as COLOR_0
description:
## Why
Blanket skip of osg `Color` in `processGeometry` drops the 3/18 models that have real COLOR_0. Most Sketchfab Color attrs are a constant engine tint (often pink + alpha≈0.5) that Blender multiplies against baseColorTexture.

## Scope
`lib/osgjs2gltf.js` only. Keep skip when the attribute is constant / tint-like; emit `COLOR_0` when there is real per-vertex variation. Do not invent cameras or LINES.

## Verification
Unit test the keep-vs-skip heuristic. Convert one of the 3 color samples from `.context/samples` and confirm COLOR_0 appears; a textured non-color model stays tint-free. `node --test`.

## Plan
`.context/plans/recover-dropped-gltf-features.md` + `.context/FINDINGS.md`
result:
## Changed
Conditional COLOR_0 export in `processGeometry`. Constant / near-constant engine tints (range ≤ 2/255 per channel, including pink+α≈0.5) stay skipped; real per-vertex RGB/RGBA becomes `COLOR_0`.

## Files
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` — `shouldKeepVertexColors`, `color0FromOsgAttr`
- `test/vertex-colors.test.js` — keep-vs-skip + processGeometry + Battle-Scarred convert

## Verification
- `npm test`: 69 pass / 0 fail
- `node --test test/vertex-colors.test.js`: 8 new tests pass
- Battle-Scarred soldier GLB (has bin, no Color) has no COLOR_0
- Fall_and_Rise osgjs declares Color; keep path proven with synthetic decoded data (sample has no `model_file.bin`)

## Risks
No real COLOR_0 GLB from a color sample (those dirs lack bins). Quiet gradients below ~2/255 still treated as tint. `processGeometry` is now exported for tests.

name: Fix review C1/M1/M2: ArrayBuffer over sendMessage -> 0-byte file; fallback race; badge 0
description:
Review found real bugs in the #3 fallback (background.js + offscreen/offscreen.js). Own those two files only.
- C1 (CRITICAL): offscreen refetchBytes returns an ArrayBuffer via sendResponse; Chrome serializes runtime messages as JSON (NOT structured clone), so it arrives as {} -> new Uint8Array({}) len 0 -> empty base64 -> data URL downloads a 0-byte file silently. FIX: encode in offscreen (which holds the bytes) to a JSON-safe STRING before sending — base64 the bytes there (chunked, 32768) and send {ok,base64,mime}; in background build data URL directly as data:<mime>;base64,<string> (no ArrayBuffer, no re-encode). A plain string always survives runtime messaging.
- M1 (minor): onChanged->interrupted fallback re-entrancy: before the retry download in the async offscreen callback, guard that the job is still live (jobs.has(uid) and phase still 'saving') to avoid a phantom download after a duplicate interrupted event advanced the queue.
- M2 (minor): badge shows '0' for queued jobs (updateBadge rounds pct=0). Make it not show '0' (e.g. show active-job count, or empty until pct>0).
result: Fixed C1 0-byte data-URL fallback (base64 string over messaging), M1 fallback re-entrancy guard, M2 badge no longer shows 0

commit.message: Fix data-URL fallback 0-byte file, re-entrancy, and badge "0"

name: Stop over-emitting material extensions
description:
## Why

Two verified material bugs: SSS is mapped to transmission (glassy skin/cloth/cards), and `getColor` ignores `factor` so default `SpecularF0=0.5` plus `SpecularColor factor:0` ships dielectric specular at ~¼ strength.

## Scope

- Delete SSS→transmission/volume fallback (`osgjs2gltf.js` `volumeThickness` block). Keep real `Opacity{refraction}` transmission.
- `getColor` (`sf-api.js`): `factor<=0` → default; else `lerp(default, color, factor)`.
- Rescale `specularFactor ≈ clamp(2 * SpecularF0, 0, 1)` (`0.5 → 1.0`).
- Gate `KHR_materials_specular` on post-rescale deviation from glTF defaults.

Keep: clearcoat, emissive_strength, ior, anisotropy, displacement.
×2 magnitude wants one visual later (deferred viewer); ship the constant now.

Design: `.context/gltf-audit/fixes/finding-4-materials.md`.

## Verification

- No `transmissionFactor:0.1` / volume from SSS; SWAT eyes `transmissionFactor:1` stays.
- Default SWAT/cards materials emit no `KHR_materials_specular`; genuine F0 deviations still emit with ×2.
- `getColor` factor-0 sheen/specular stays default.
- `npm test`.

## Handoff

Record remaining author-vs-ours extension deltas and whether the ×2 constant still wants a viewer check.
result:
## What changed

SSS is no longer mapped to glassy `KHR_materials_transmission`/`KHR_materials_volume`. `getColor` honors channel `factor` (0 → default; 0..1 lerp). Sketchfab `SpecularF0` is rescaled `clamp(2 * F0, 0, 1)` so the dielectric default `0.5` becomes glTF `specularFactor` `1.0` and is omitted. Specular emits only on post-rescale deviation, non-white color, or a specular-color texture.

## Files changed

- `lib/sf-api.js` — `getColor` factor-aware lerp
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` — F0 ×2 + specular gate; deleted `volumeThickness` emit block
- `test/materials.test.js` — factor parse + convert gates

## Commands run

- `node --test test/materials.test.js test/viewer-scene.test.js` — 20/20 pass (2 new)
- `node --test test/materials.test.js test/viewer-scene.test.js test/orm.test.js test/primitives.test.js` — 43/43
- `npm test` — remaining fails are pre-existing `.context/samples` ENOENT

## Verification

Live embed parse + synthetic convert (`makeMaterial` path):

- SWAT 15 mats: trans 0.1 = 0, volume = 0, trans 1 = eyes only, specular = patch 0.707 / uniform 0.315 / eyes 0.845. Face SSS 0.005 dropped. Emissive on g2 + NVG kept.
- Queen 6 mats: skin SSS 2.376 and cloth 0.310 emit no transmission/volume. Skin/cloth emit specular from tint `[0.95,0.95,0.95]`. Default dielectrics omit.
- Cards 3 mats: Material.001 SSS 0.060 dropped, clearcoat kept, F0 0.559 clamps to 1 and omits specular. Material.003 emits 0.450.

Unit: factor-0 SpecularColor/Sheen stay default; refraction stays `transmissionFactor:1`.

## Risks / leftover

- Queen `sword` still emits specular from a near-neutral viewer tint `[0.95]` (F0 is default 0.5). Gate is correct; author file may omit it.
- ×2 F0 magnitude still wants a deferred visual side-by-side; the constant is shipped.
- SSS glow is omitted (no ratified glTF SSS). Do not re-add via transmission.

## Next

Parent epic is ready to close once this leaf is done.

name: lib CRC32 dedup + reconsider PNG decode order (#10, #8)
description:
Owns lib/descramble.js, lib/zip.js, new lib/crc32.js. See plan Task 3.
- #10 (minor): extract ONE shared lib/crc32.js exporting the offset form crc32(u8,start,len). zip.js + descramble.js import it. zip.js's whole-buffer callers -> crc32(data,0,data.length). test/zip.test.js imports crc32 from zip.js -> keep zip.js re-exporting (or update test import). npm test must stay green.
- #8 (important, RECONSIDER/likely defer): current 'custom PNG parser first' order (decodeToRgba, descramble.js:536) is a CORRECTNESS choice — decodeViaBitmap round-trips createImageBitmap->canvas (lossy premultiply/color-mgmt, corrupts ORM/normal maps). npm test CANNOT catch a regression (Node lacks ImageDecoder/createImageBitmap). If pursued: prefer ImageDecoder ONLY (exact copyTo RGBA), never move canvas path ahead of custom parser; requires manual browser pixel comparison. Otherwise return 'no change, premise did not hold'.
Verify: npm test (zip/descramble/orm) green.
result: Extracted shared lib/crc32.js (offset-capable crc32); zip.js re-exports whole-buffer wrapper, descramble.js imports it; #8 PNG decode order left unchanged (correctness-motivated, unverifiable in Node)

name: Fix review I1: panel.js navigate event fires pre-commit -> SPA re-sync broken
description:
Review found #4 regression in content/panel.js. Own that file only.
- I1 (IMPORTANT): the 'navigate' event fires BEFORE navigation commits, so location.href is still the old URL inside the handler and onNav's (location.href===lastHref) guard blocks the re-sync -> button never updates on SPA model-to-model nav. FIX: listen for 'navigatesuccess' instead of 'navigate' (fires post-commit, URL updated), OR read event.destination.url in the handler. Keep the feature-detect + else-branch setInterval poll fallback intact.
result: Listen for Navigation API navigatesuccess (post-commit URL) instead of navigate so the button re-syncs on SPA model-to-model navigation

name: Never silently ship a static rig
description:
## Why

A failed animation-bin fetch only warns; the popup still goes green and the user gets a static rig. That is the live F2 bug. The eagle 403 URL is already fixed in HEAD; harden candidates so a CDN-layout mismatch self-heals.

## Scope

- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js`: add `animationBinUrlCandidates` (official already preferred in pipeline). Keep `animationBinUrl` as `candidates[0]`.
- `lib/pipeline.js`: `extraAnimationBins` (match official URLs by hash, not index); try candidates until a valid bin; detect `animBinNames.length > 0 && emitted === 0 && failed > 0`; force a debug/source zip; return `{ error }`.
- `offscreen/offscreen.js`: emit `done` then `error` when `error` is set (file still delivered).
- `background.js`: if `error` arrives while `saving`/`done`, set `job.error` without `failJob` (must not break `findSavingJob` / `finishSave`). Preserve error phase after a successful save.
- `popup/popup.js`: show `job.error` in the summary and paint the bar red (`progressClass` already maps `error`).

Out of scope: F3 channel folding; live eagle re-audit (nice if cheap).

Design: `.context/gltf-audit/fixes/finding-2-anim-fetch.md` + FIX_PLAN F2.

## Verification

- Unit: `animationBinUrlCandidates` eagle URL → `/animations/` first, sibling `/files/` later.
- `extraAnimationBins` hash-matches official; retries next candidate after a not-bin/403.
- `animationLossError` (or equivalent) fires only on total loss.
- `node --test test/animations.test.js` + full `npm test`.
- curl eagle `/animations/` → 200 vs sibling `/files/` → 403.

## Handoff

Record the result-shape (`{ filename, bytes, kind, error }`), how error-after-done is guarded, and any leftover live-extension check.
result:
## What changed

Failed anim-bin fetches no longer ship as a quiet success. The pipeline tries an ordered URL candidate list per bin, and total animation loss returns `{ error }` plus a debug zip. Offscreen still emits `done` (file saves) then `error`. Background keeps the job in `saving` so `findSavingJob`/`finishSave` work, then paints the row red. Popup prefers `job.error` and the red `progress.error` bar.

## Files changed

- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` — `animationBinUrlCandidates`; `animationBinUrl` is `candidates[0]`
- `lib/pipeline.js` — `extraAnimationBins`, `animationLossError`, candidate fetch loop, force zip + `error` on total loss (and on the catch debug-zip path)
- `offscreen/offscreen.js` — `done` then `error` when `error` is set
- `background.js` — attach error during `saving`/`done`; `finishSave` preserves error phase
- `popup/popup.js` — `job.error` wins last-log and bar class
- `test/animations.test.js` — candidate order, official hash-match, loss-error gating

## Commands run

- `node --test test/animations.test.js` — 3 new tests pass (`animationBinUrlCandidates`, `extraAnimationBins`, `animationLossError`). Pre-existing sample-file ENOENTs still fail (snakes / BulkHead missing from this worktree).
- `curl -sI` eagle `/animations/54aede….bin.gz` → HTTP 200 (168855 B); sibling `/files/aa62…/54aede….bin.gz` → HTTP 403.
- Chrome DevTools: popup error-state preview (green success vs red "Animation lost…" bar); live eagle page confirms clip `motion4`.

## Verification

- Candidate[0] is the working `/animations/` URL; sibling is present later.
- Official URLs pair by hash, not list index.
- `animationLossError` is null unless `names>0 && emitted===0 && failed>0`.
- Result shape is `{ filename, bytes, kind, error? }`. Error after `done` does not call `failJob` (would drop the row and skip `finishSave`).

## Browser observations

Popup CSS: `progress.error` is red (`#d1242f`), `progress.done` is green; error summary truncates with ellipsis. Live eagle page is up with clip `motion4`. Did **not** reload the unpacked extension and re-download eagle end-to-end.

## Remaining risks or follow-ups

- Live extension smoke: reload unpacked, download eagle (expect clip + green), then force a 403 (expect red + debug zip).
- Sample fixtures are missing in this worktree; those older tests stay ENOENT until samples are restored.

## Next recommended task

`sxr5oox7` — Emit KHR_texture_transform from UVTransforms (F1). Field names already verified: channel `UVTransforms`, texture `texCoordUnit`.

name: Emit named node hierarchy instead of baking
description:
## Why
We flatten 6180 osg.MatrixTransform / osg.Node matrices into vertices. Skins and morphs need a real node tree. Static models must keep the same world placement (Y-up flip stays correct).

## Scope
`lib/osgjs2gltf.js`: `collectGeometries` walk + emit. Named nodes + TRS; stop `applyMatrixToVertices` for placement once nodes carry the transform. Keep current mesh/PBR/UV behavior. Same file as colors — do not start in parallel with that leaf.

## Verification
Static samples (BulkHead_Door, Iveco truck, Etalon) look unchanged. Named nodes present. Existing `test/transform.test.js` + `node --test` still pass. This is the prereq artifact for skinning and morphs.

## Plan
`.context/plans/recover-dropped-gltf-features.md` + `.context/FINDINGS.md`
result:
## Changed
Named glTF node graph replaces placement baking. `osg.MatrixTransform` / `osg.Node` / Bone / Skeleton emit named nodes; local mesh verts stay local; node matrices conjugated `M' = R M R⁻¹` so composed world matches the old bake+Y-up path.

## Files
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` — `conjugateZupToYup`, graph walk, `buildGLTF` wires `options.graph`
- `test/hierarchy.test.js` — nested MT world-match + Battle-Scarred tree

## Verification
- `npm test`: 72 pass / 0 fail
- Nested translations: local POSITION, world within 1e-5 of bake+Y-up
- Battle-Scarred convert is a named node tree, not a flat mesh soup
- Reviewer: PASS (fresh `npm test` 72/72)

## Risks
Rig/Morph meshes now inherit parent node matrices (old path used `worldMatrix = null`). Inverse-bind matrices on the skin leaf must use the same conjugate `R`. Extra Skeleton/Node wrappers are not joints.

name: Emit KHR_texture_transform from UVTransforms
description:
## Why

Author dyson tiles textures via per-channel offset/scale/rotation; we emit none, so maps tile 1×. High osgjs UV slots are UniqueID aliases — not data loss. The transform lives in the material API, not osgjs.

## Scope

- `lib/sf-api.js parseViewerMaterials`: read each channel's `UVTransforms` `{offset, scale, rotation}` and `texture.texCoordUnit`. Carry both on the spec per texture role.
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js`: thread onto `map`; `texRef()` replaces hardcoded `texCoord:0`; emit `KHR_texture_transform` when non-identity; register `extensionsUsed`; include transform + texCoord in `materialIndexFor` cache key.
- Identity `{offset:[0,0], scale:[1,1], rotation:0}` → no extension.

**Live field names (verified 2026-08-20, dyson `781280bf2a3f4e8b923220106832df10`):**
- Channel: `UVTransforms` (plural), not `UVTransform` / `uv`.
- Texture: `texCoordUnit` (number).
- `MAT_METAL_1` albedo/normal/metal/rough: `{offset:[0,-14], scale:[10,15], rotation:0}`, unit `1`.
- `MAT_LIGHT_1` albedo: `{offset:[-1,0], scale:[3,3], rotation:2.778…}`, unit `3`.
- Black-rat fur (viewer-faithful): albedo unit `1`, normal unit `0`. Do not invent author `TEXCOORD_1` for the normal.

Out of scope: re-emitting alias UV sets; side-by-side viewer (deferred).

Design: FIX_PLAN F1 (corrected location). Ignore finding-1's osgjs UserData path.

## Verification

- Unit: parse `UVTransforms` + identity omission + cache-key split.
- Dyson convert: metal/light transforms match author within 1e-4; `extensionsUsed` includes `KHR_texture_transform`.
- Queen/plane: no transform extension.
- `npm test`.

## Handoff

Record the spec field names used, how texCoordUnit maps to glTF `texCoord`, and any residual (black_rat normal vs author).
result:
## What changed

Viewer channel `UVTransforms` now survive as `KHR_texture_transform`. Identity transforms are omitted. OSG `texCoordUnit` is stored but glTF `texCoord` stays 0 — units 1/3 on dyson are aliases of the kept `TEXCOORD_0`. Material cache key includes `uv` so two materials that share a texture but tile differently do not collapse.

## Files changed

- `lib/sf-api.js` — `normalizeUvTransform`, `readChannelUv`, `spec.uv` per role
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` — `map.uv`, `texRef()` on every texture info, `tx:` cache key
- `test/materials.test.js` — parse + convert coverage

## Commands run

- `node --test test/materials.test.js` — 12/12 pass
- `node --test test/viewer-scene.test.js test/orm.test.js test/primitives.test.js` — 29/29 pass
- Live embed `781280bf…` → parse + synthetic convert: metal `offset[0,-14] scale[10,15]` and light albedo `offset[-1,0] scale[3,3] rotation:2.778` match author within 1e-4; `MAT_LIGHT_3` identity omitted

## Verification

- Identity `{0,0}/{1,1}/0` → no extension
- Distinct tilings on the same albedo uid emit two materials
- `extensionsUsed` includes `KHR_texture_transform`
- All texture refs still `texCoord: 0`

## Browser observations

Comparison table of live dyson parse vs emitted KHR: metal and light MATCH ≤1e-4; identity omit correct. Side-by-side viewer (tiling look) still deferred.

## Remaining risks or follow-ups

- `texCoordUnit` is not used as glTF `texCoord` (would invent missing TEXCOORD_1/3 on dyson). Black-rat fur normal stays unit 0 / `TEXCOORD_0` (viewer-faithful; author is `TEXCOORD_1`).
- Visual tiling confirmation waits for the deferred viewer.

## Next recommended task

`yt7oul1f` — Fold ScalingCompensation into scale

name: background+offscreen: SW keepalive, download fallback, badge (#1,#3,#7,#9,#12)
description:
Owns background.js + offscreen/offscreen.js. Do NOT touch manifest.json or DEBUG. See plan Task 4.
- #1 (critical, VERIFY FIRST): setInterval keepalive (background.js:124-131) is the standard working MV3 pattern; getPlatformInfo resets the 30s idle timer. chrome.alarms min period 30s >= 30s idle => naive swap REGRESSES. Reproduce a real SW-death-during-download first; if none, leave as-is (valid PASS). If real, prefer hybrid (keep setInterval + alarm backstop), and tell Task 1 to add 'alarms' permission.
- #3 (critical): keep blob primary. Add data-URL fallback on BOTH failure paths: (a) download() callback lastError/no downloadId (background.js:277), (b) downloads.onChanged -> interrupted (background.js:358). Fallback: request raw bytes from offscreen (offscreen.js currently keeps only the object URL, L55 — must ALSO retain Blob/bytes per id, freed on revoke/confirm), build chunked-base64 data:<mime> URL in SW, retry download once. Note memory cost.
- #7 (important): chrome.action.setBadgeText progress badge (action key exists, manifest:11); clear on queue drain / failJob / finishSave.
- #9 (minor): drop 'WORKERS' from offscreen reasons (background.js:176), keep 'BLOBS'; confirm no Worker spawned first (declarative only).
- #12 (minor): remove typeof chrome.downloads.search guard (background.js:364), call directly.
Verify: npm test green + manual: real download lands via blob; badge shows/clears.
result: Data-URL download fallback (both paths, single retry) + offscreen refetchBytes, progress badge, dropped WORKERS, removed downloads.search guard; #1 keepalive left as-is (setInterval getPlatformInfo correct MV3 idle reset)

name: Close glTF conversion fidelity gaps
description:
# Plan: Close remaining osgjs → GLB fidelity gaps

Source of truth: `.context/gltf-audit/FIX_PLAN.md` (per-finding designs in `.context/gltf-audit/fixes/`).

## Summary

Four converter bugs survive the recovered-features work. North star: lose no data glTF supports; match the author download as closely as the viewer data allows.

## Non-negotiable constraints

- Quiet logging: errors surface, no debug spam.
- Do not invent cameras, wireframe `LINES`, or unratified SSS.
- Never ship an animated model as a silent static GLB.
- Do not put dex ids in commits or docs.

## Deferred, with intent

- Side-by-side viewer — build when implementing F1 tiling / F4 specular ×2 visual confirmation, not as its own leaf now.
- `KHR_materials_diffuse_transmission` SSS approximation — do not start without a new task.

name: Recover dropped osgjs → GLB features
description:
# Recover dropped osgjs → GLB features

Inventory and counts: `.context/FINDINGS.md` (18 sample models).

We already export meshes (positions, normals, tangents, all UV sets, triangles + strips) and full PBR materials. This plan recovers the glTF-representable data we currently drop. Do not add cameras (none in osgjs) or wireframe `LINES` (viewer-regenerated helpers).

## Constraint

Geometry, skin weights, vertex colors, morph targets, hierarchy, and lights all live in files we already download (`model_file.bin` + `file.osgjs`). Animation **keyframes** live in separate `<hash>.bin.gz` files the pipeline never fetches — that is the only network-scope change.

## Build order

1. **Vertex colors** — stop the blanket `Color` skip in `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` (`processGeometry`). Emit `COLOR_0` only when the attribute is real variation, not a constant engine tint. 3/18 models. No extra download.
2. **Node hierarchy** — emit named glTF nodes + TRS instead of baking 6180 `osg.MatrixTransform` / `osg.Node` matrices into vertices (`collectGeometries` walk + `applyMatrixToVertices`). Prerequisite for skins and morphs. Keep Y-up conversion correct.
3. **Skinning** — 6/18 models: `JOINTS_0` / `WEIGHTS_0` from Bones/Weights attrs, plus `skins`, skeleton, inverse-bind matrices from `osgAnimation.Skeleton` / `Bone`. Data already in `model_file.bin` + osgjs. Bind-pose mesh is already saved.
4. **Morph targets** — 5/18 models: keep `osgAnimation.MorphGeometry` targets instead of flattening to the base mesh. Data already in `model_file.bin`.
5. **Lights** — optional, low value (`KHR_lights_punctual`; look like default directionals). Skip unless leftover after 1–4.
6. **Animations** — the large leaf. Discover + download `<hash>.bin.gz`, gunzip, decode `Float32` and `CompressedPacked` (varint + quantized Uint16) channels, emit named `animations[]` (18 clips today, 15/18 models). Do last. Needs hierarchy (and skins/morphs if those channels target them).

## Primary files

- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` — converter (all features)
- `lib/pipeline.js` — extra fetch only for animations
- `lib/sf-api.js` / `lib/decrypt.js` — only if anim bin URLs need discovery/decrypt
- `test/*.test.js` — fold verification into the leaf that changes the behavior (`node --test`)
- Samples: `.context/samples/*/file.osgjs` + `model_file.bin`

## Done when

A GLB from a skinned/morphed/animated sample keeps: vertex colors when real, a named node tree (not a baked soup), skins + morph targets, and named animation clips. Static-only models (BulkHead_Door, Iveco truck, Etalon) stay visually unchanged. Existing mesh/PBR/UV tests still pass.

name: Fold ScalingCompensation into scale
description:
## Why

Droid's 70 dropped channels are exactly 70 `ScalingCompensation` tracks (`unknown-path`). glTF forbids two channels on one `(node, scale)`, so they must fold into scale via component-wise product.

## Scope

`lib/osgjs2gltf.js` only:
- `gltfPathForChannel`: `scalingcompensation` → sentinel `scaleCompensation` (not `scale`).
- Emit loop: defer scale + compensation per node (mirror `weightGroups`); `combineScaleTracks` + vec3 sample; apply Y-up remap once on the product.

Out of scope: new decode types; emitting a second scale channel.

Design: `.context/gltf-audit/fixes/finding-3-anim-channels.md`.

## Verification

- Droid skip count 70→0; glTF still 217 channels (71 scale after fold).
- Spot-check `CC_Base_L_ToeBaseShareBone_0` scale equals scale⊙compensation.
- Other models' channel counts unchanged.
- `npm test`.

## Handoff

Record skip/emitted counts and whether any non-droid model also had compensation tracks.
result:
## What changed

`ScalingCompensation` is recognized as a sentinel path and folded into the node's `scale` channel (component-wise product on the union timeline). glTF still has one scale channel per node. Y-up remap runs once on the product. Lone scale or lone compensation still emits as scale.

## Files changed

- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` — `gltfPathForChannel`, `sampleVec3`, `combineScaleTracks`, emit-loop `scaleGroups`
- `test/animations.test.js` — product unit test + convert fold test on `CC_Base_L_ToeBaseShareBone_0`

## Commands run

- `node --test test/animations.test.js` — new tests pass (`combineScaleTracks`, `ScalingCompensation folds…`). Pre-existing sample ENOENTs unchanged.

## Verification

- Synthetic: scale [2,1,3] ⊙ [0.5,2,1] = [1,2,3]; after Y-up remap accessor is [1,3,2].
- `animDebug.skipped === 0`, no `unknown-path`, exactly one `scale` channel.
- Audit `info.json` files: `ScalingCompensation` appears only on the droid sample. Other models have no compensation tracks.

## Browser observations

Summary table of droid accounting (287→217, 70 folded not dropped). Could not re-convert the live droid bundle — work dir has debug JSON only, no osgjs/anim bins.

## Remaining risks or follow-ups

- Full droid re-convert (skip 70→0, 217 channels) needs a fresh download with keyframe bins.
- Fold is exact for adjacent diagonal scales; stacked-element order was not byte-verified on droid osgjs.
